correctness.rationale: Here smooth parameters refer to the squarefree branch model. A multiple root is nonzero and satisfies x³=a and x²=3/a, equivalent to a⁵=−1 (in the converse take x=a²/3). Otherwise the tame cubic cover has six totally ramified points, so g=4. At finite branch points dx has order 2 and y order 1; at infinity x,y,dx have orders −3,−5,−4. These checks give the four stated differentials as a basis. Applying Cartier to x^j F^(2i)dx/y^(7i) for i=1,2 gives the displayed coefficient matrix with seventh roots, including the zero singleton block. Its constant nonzero minor and zero determinant prove Cartier rank two. The properly twisted two-step minor is 3a⁴(a¹⁰−1). When it is nonzero, each factor maps the preceding rank-two image injectively onto its own rank-two image, so every longer twisted product has rank two. At a=0 the matrix cubes to zero. On a⁵=1, scaling suffices to check a=1; there the coefficients are in F7 and the characteristic polynomial is z²(z−2), giving stable rank one. This also agrees with the independently reproduced four-step rank-one product. Taking fifth roots and applying ζ↦ζ² proves the asserted orbit without claiming all isomorphisms. The finite-field point checks are corroboration only. Independent arithmetic replay: /workspace/branches/347bad69-6f7b-4b19-918d-d53ce542267e/independent_check.py.
